# classic-stylesheets Mac OS 9 recipes and assets

The Platinum control geometry, state recipes, tab silhouettes, control arrows,
and checkmark used by AI System 6 are adapted from the Mac OS 9 theme in
[nielssp/classic-stylesheets](https://github.com/nielssp/classic-stylesheets)
at commit `9ebd2d84664095345097a71e1a137f985d03d4f2`.

The copied CSS relationships are isolated behind AI System 6's Platinum
Appearance and shared Theme Lab control layer; the third-party global selectors
and DOM conventions are not imported. The assets remain small, inspectable SVGs
with their original pixel-sized view boxes (7 x 10 popup arrows, 4/8px scrollbar
arrows, 6 x 11 submenu arrow, and 74 x 23/25 tabs). The disabled popup arrow is
a color-state adaptation of the same source geometry. See `LICENSE.txt` in this
directory.
